note: Armour protection and damage modes (catalog Phase 4b, M001-T14; master s3.6 roles, s3.7 rules 1-3). Read by src/stream/server_items.gd (hurt_player, protection_of) and checked by validate_items. Every number here and every items.json protect / cover / damage_mode / pen / reach_m / recover_ms value is s5 tuning for playtest. A worn piece's items.json protect gives, for each damage mode, the share of a hit it stops on the part of its slot it covers; cover is that part (a breastplate guards the front of the body, 0.55; a hauberk nearly all of it, 0.95). Per slot and mode the pieces' protect x cover combine largest first, each further layer counting layer_keep times the one before (the clothing warmth rule, server_items _layered), capped at slot_cap; a weapon's pen (armour penetration) scales that down by (1 - pen). A hit counts each slot by its slot share (where blows land, summing to 1), so a body piece alone stops at most its share; the total is capped at cap, so no outfit is immune. A broken piece (wear at its maximum) protects nothing until it is mended. Each hit wears every worn piece with protect and durability by the hit's damage x wear_per_damage x its cover (at least 1). Attacks from animals and goblins take their mode from attack_modes by species, else default_mode; a fall, cold, hunger or sickness is not an attack and armour never touches it. Armour weight (weights.json; worn pieces with protect and a durability) past effort_free_kg is work on the move: effort_per_kg x those kilograms x how much the player is moving, added to the exertion. Clothing and light leather (a jerkin, apron, shoes, hat) stay under the free kilograms, so a walk stays restful (exertion.json rest_effort, Dave 10 Nov 2026); mail over a gambeson is about at the line, plate is real work. Heat comes from the pieces' warmth and fabric (warmth.json layers). Each hit wearing every protecting piece (not one piece picked by hit location) is an s5 tuning choice.

attack_modes.note: A bite or a tusk pierces, claws slash, a charge, kick, butt or club is blunt (the default).
